body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) Glaringaphid53
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned Hacking : Flying
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. Because i won't Hack again, i will delete all of my hacks from my Computer, And never use them again.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? No, it wasn't. I accept my mistakes, And i apologize for ruining the players performance.
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? No, Because it wasn't false.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? No. Its been since yesterday since i've been banned.
  • Have I been caught ban evading? No.
  • Have I appealed a ban before? No, i haven't. I haven't joined this server in a while, infact.
